notes.f1: Claudine (I8, chr. 12 Oct 1781) is attached to Philippe Thenot and Marie Joly, not to Marie Badoux; no 1781 fact on Marie Badoux, whose only child in the tree is Jean (1780). The extra 27 Jun 1780 marriage date on the Badoux couple does not bear on this finding.
notes.f2: ps_001 gives both refuting routes: Marie Badoux died 21 Mar 1780, nineteen months before the baptism, and the mother named is a different woman. It oddly says the 1781 baptism itself was not found, and does not state outright that no record gives her a daughter, but the required negative conclusion is documented.
